div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-human-oversight-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: A human reviewer assessed the AI output and accepted it without changing its substantive content.
A human reviewer rejected the AI output or recommendation.
A human reviewer corrected erroneous or incomplete AI-generated content while retaining the corrected result as the documented outcome.

title.value: EU AI Human Oversight Code System

description.value: Codes describing actions taken by a human reviewer in response to an AI-generated output or recommendation.
